evidenceIndex.claim: Defines authority order, full-stack trace, branch pinning, WLT financial ownership and evidence discipline.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain planning must follow current task → governance → Product Truth → pinned implementation, and must trace all affected consumers.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Normative authority; does not itself prove implementation correctness.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines diagnosis/package-only execution and schema-driven coverage requirements.
evidenceIndex.result: This run may create planning artifacts only; product/runtime/governance code is not to be modified.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Planning command; implementation remains future work.

evidenceIndex.claim: Requested architecture source was inspected on the pinned SHA.
evidenceIndex.result: The file is zero bytes and cannot provide architectural evidence for this package.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Empty source; architecture conclusions must come from code/contracts/Product Truth.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows Captain runtime composition and access gates.
evidenceIndex.result: Identity requires captain/app-captain, Workforce readiness gates DSH surface, SecureStore session/device fingerprint and push registration are composed before Captain UI.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static composition does not prove device/runtime behavior.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows Captain surface route and feature composition.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain UI covers home/orders/notifications/account, active assignment actions, task execution, PoD, support, availability/service mode and finance entry points.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Presence does not prove every action is contract-bound or runtime-correct.

evidenceIndex.claim: Identifies the shared Captain frontend brain.
evidenceIndex.result: Surface composes lifecycle/actions/policy, PoD, chat, availability, GPS/navigation/profile/service mode/inbox and Captain runtime from shared modules.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static binding does not prove generated-contract parity or backend persistence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows foreground Captain location and delivery mutations.
evidenceIndex.result: Accept/decline/pickup/exception/location are DSH-bound; active foreground location is sampled about every three minutes and no background task/history is declared.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Foreground-only behavior may be intentional; requirement must be verified before changing it.

evidenceIndex.claim: Enumerates Captain, operator, client and partner dispatch operations.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain owns accept/decline/status/PoD/exception actions; operator owns assignment/reassignment/resolution; client/partner receive governed tracking/readback.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Frontend adapter does not prove server route registration, transactions or database invariants.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines Captain dispatch Product Truth, journey 102 and affected surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: DSH owns assignment truth; control-panel/app-captain/app-client are required; idempotency, capacity, expiry, isolation and operator readback are mandatory.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Decision is implemented-pending-verification; independent reviews remain pending.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines store↔Captain custody Product Truth, journey 105.
evidenceIndex.result: app-partner/app-captain/control-panel are required, app-client is readback, app-field is explicitly excluded; pickup must be blocked until bilateral custody completes.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Compatibility Product Truth; same-candidate runtime/database evidence still required.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines partner fleet connection boundaries.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain redeems one-time codes/lists/disconnects own memberships; partner and operator read the same DSH fleet truth with audit/version/isolation requirements.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Approved product model; protected reviews/runtime proof remain separate.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines Captain support and order rescue boundaries.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain may open/send/read support only for assigned orders; control-panel operates incidents/rescue; DSH remains operational truth and WLT is visibility-only.
evidenceIndex.limitations: State is discovery; implementation completeness is not established.

evidenceIndex.claim: Defines WLT-owned Captain commission lifecycle.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain must read own commission states and adjustment reasons through canonical WLT-backed readback; Captain is read-only and cannot submit/settle/reverse amounts.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Capability remains discovery and requires finance/security/runtime evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Shows current Captain finance composition.
evidenceIndex.result: COD liability is WLT-backed through governed DSH proxy, while aggregate Captain earnings are explicitly unavailable and settlement is partnerId-oriented in current UI.
evidenceIndex.limitations: This exposes a Product Truth gap; it does not authorize inventing Captain settlement mutations.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current control-panel HR sovereign source inventory.
evidenceIndex.result: CaptainCreateView, CaptainDetailView and CaptainFleetMembershipsPanel directly manage/read Captain-related workforce/fleet state.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory inventory does not prove all controls are correctly authorized or persisted.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current operations inventory includes Captain-relevant operational surfaces.
evidenceIndex.result: DispatchAssignment/DispatchOperations, DeliveryProofReview, ExceptionsEscalations and OrderRescue are direct Captain journey readers/writers.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Directory inventory contains unrelated operations too; only Captain-linked screens are in scope.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current administration inventory includes role assignment/definition approval queues.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain role/access approval paths can affect app-captain authorization and therefore require scoped verification.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Generic administration features remain out of scope unless they affect Captain role/access.

evidenceIndex.claim: Provides discovery grouping and closure discipline.
evidenceIndex.result: 107 journeys are grouped with contracts/migrations/runtime/CI/same-SHA gates and zero unmapped controls/parallel truths.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Derived planning support only; not Product Truth and cannot establish requirements by itself.

evidenceIndex.claim: Implementation locations discovered for Captain dispatch backend and contract.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain dispatch adapter maps to governed DSH backend/contract locations that must be verified together.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Paths were discovered statically; route-level and PostgreSQL proof is future execution.

evidenceIndex.claim: WLT shared frontend inventory contains Captain COD and finance integration pieces.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain COD has dedicated controllers/API while general finance modules must be included only when Captain Product Truth consumes them.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Inventory does not prove backend financial invariants or actor isolation.

entries.name: control-panel
entries.summary: Required only for Captain workforce/access, partner fleet, dispatch/handoff, support/rescue and WLT finance operator readback.

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Required only as Captain delivery tracking/order-state readback consumer; customer address ownership remains outside Captain scope.

entries.name: app-partner
entries.summary: Required only for partner-fleet connection, store↔Captain custody, return/handoff consequences and their authoritative readback.

entries.name: app-captain
entries.summary: Primary surface including access, profile, fleet, availability, dispatch, execution, location, PoD/support and WLT-backed finance.

entries.name: app-field
entries.summary: Assessed explicitly to prevent scope bleed.
entries.exclusionReason: Store↔Captain custody Product Truth explicitly excludes app-field, and Captain commission readback does not mutate or determine field representative commission truth.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a Captain change is proven to alter a shared policy/schema/state read by app-field or Product Truth adds app-field to that exact Captain journey.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Only Captain role/access approval controls are in scope; generic administration remains excluded inside the unit boundary.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: No current Captain Product Truth requires analytics as a writer or mandatory Captain readback surface.
entries.exclusionReason: Captain-required operator actions are registered under operations/partners/support/HR/finance, not analytics.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if a Product Truth or current implementation makes a Captain decision depend on analytics state or mandates Captain-specific analytic readback.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Catalog ownership does not participate in authenticated Captain assignment, custody, execution, support, fleet or finance lifecycle.
entries.exclusionReason: No direct Captain control or truth dependency was found in the applicable Product Truth set.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if Captain eligibility/execution becomes contractually dependent on a catalog mutation or readback.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a required Captain writer/readback in the applicable Product Truth set.
entries.exclusionReason: Captain operator actions are explicitly represented in operations and support; no dashboard-specific acceptance criterion was found.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if dashboard becomes the canonical operator readback for Captain readiness, dispatch, custody, incidents or finance.

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Captain create/detail/fleet membership surfaces directly affect Captain Workforce identity/readiness and memberships.

entries.name: login
entries.summary: Control-panel operator login is infrastructure for operators, not part of the Captain app journey itself.
entries.exclusionReason: app-captain has its own IdentitySessionGate; no Captain state is owned by the control-panel login page.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen only if a Captain Product Truth explicitly requires a control-panel login flow behavior beyond generic operator authentication.

entries.name: marketing
entries.summary: Marketing does not own Captain access, assignment, custody, support, fleet, location, proof or finance truth.
entries.exclusionReason: No applicable Captain Product Truth lists marketing as a required surface or dependency.
entries.reopenTrigger: Reopen if a Captain compensation/dispatch eligibility rule is explicitly governed by a marketing capability.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Dispatch, proof review, exceptions/escalations and order rescue directly read or mutate Captain journeys.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Operator partner-fleet readback is required for the same DSH membership truth consumed by Captain and partner surfaces.

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Only service-area/capacity policy that directly gates Captain dispatch eligibility is in scope; client-address/privacy ownership is excluded.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Captain assigned-order support must converge with the operator support queue and rescue state without local truth.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: Finance operator lifecycle and readback are required for WLT-owned Captain commissions/COD where current Product Truth applies.

entries.name: captain-product-truth
entries.summary: Applicable Captain Product Truth records define requirements and ownership; planning registry is discovery-only.

entries.name: architecture-evidence
entries.summary: Requested architecture.drawio is empty; actual dependency map must be derived from pinned code/contracts/Product Truth.

entries.name: app-captain-runtime
entries.summary: Secure session, device identity, Workforce gate, push registration, native permissions and lifecycle require Captain-specific runtime verification.

entries.name: captain-shared-frontend
entries.summary: Captain surface binding and shared delivery/dispatch/support/finance adapters must remain the reusable frontend brain with no surface-local truth.

entries.name: captain-dsh-wlt-contracts
entries.summary: Captain dispatch/handoff/support/finance operations require contract/source/generated-consumer parity.

entries.name: captain-backend-domain
entries.summary: Identity/Workforce, DSH dispatch/custody/support and WLT commission/COD handlers must enforce trusted actor scope and legal state transitions.

entries.name: captain-persistence
entries.summary: Captain profile/readiness, fleet memberships, assignments/custody/exceptions/proofs and financial records require durable versioned/idempotent persistence.

entries.name: captain-auth-isolation-privacy
entries.summary: Captain actor identity, role/surface gates, store/order scope, location, support messages, media and financial reads require negative isolation/privacy proof.

entries.name: captain-same-sha-evidence
entries.summary: Every implemented unit requires targeted static, contract, backend, PostgreSQL, runtime and cross-surface evidence on the final candidate SHA.
